2026-07-29.title: Wake up and prepare
2026-07-29.detail: Complete final packing. Check the Grindelwald First and Kleine Scheidegg webcams, SBB connections and weather. Wear walking shoes and carry a warm layer, rain jacket, water, sunscreen and power bank.
2026-07-29.note: Ask the Lucerne hotel the previous evening for a packed breakfast.

2026-07-29.title: Hotel → Lucerne station
2026-07-29.detail: Check out and walk or take transport to Lucerne station. Reach the station no later than 05:50.
2026-07-29.note: Eat part of the packed breakfast at the station or on the train.

2026-07-29.title: Luzern–Interlaken Express
2026-07-29.detail: Take the direct scenic train from Lucerne to Interlaken Ost. The route passes Lake Sarnen, Lake Lungern, Brünig Pass, Meiringen and Lake Brienz.
2026-07-29.note: Sit on the right-hand side initially, although views change sides. No panoramic surcharge is required.

2026-07-29.title: Change at Interlaken Ost
2026-07-29.detail: Follow signs for the Bernese Oberland Railway. Do not leave the station during the short connection.
2026-07-29.note: Use station coffee or food shops only when the connection allows at least 15–20 minutes.

2026-07-29.title: Interlaken Ost → Grindelwald
2026-07-29.detail: Take the direct train to Grindelwald, approximately 35 minutes.
2026-07-29.note: Keep your camera accessible as the Eiger becomes visible near Grindelwald.

2026-07-29.title: Hotel luggage drop
2026-07-29.detail: Walk to your Grindelwald hotel, leave the main suitcase and carry only a daypack. Confirm evening check-in arrangements.
2026-07-29.note: Do not wait for the room to be ready.

2026-07-29.title: Walk to First gondola station
2026-07-29.detail: Walk approximately 10–15 minutes along Dorfstrasse to the Grindelwald First valley station.
2026-07-29.note: A local bus is possible, but walking is normally simpler.
2026-07-29.map_query: Grindelwald First gondola valley station, Switzerland

2026-07-29.title: Gondola to First
2026-07-29.detail: Ride Grindelwald → Bort → Schreckfeld → First.
2026-07-29.note: Look back over Grindelwald Valley during the ascent.

2026-07-29.title: First arrival and viewpoint walk
2026-07-29.detail: Walk directly toward the cliff walk before larger crowds arrive.
2026-07-29.note: Avoid stopping at the restaurant immediately.

2026-07-29.title: First Cliff Walk
2026-07-29.detail: Complete the cliff-side walkway, suspension section and viewing platform.
2026-07-29.note: Allow additional time for photographs of the Eiger, Wetterhorn and Schreckhorn.
2026-07-29.map_query: First Cliff Walk by Tissot, Grindelwald, Switzerland

2026-07-29.title: First View and summit area
2026-07-29.detail: Explore the main viewpoint and surrounding panorama. Wait briefly when clouds are moving, as peaks may reappear.
2026-07-29.note: Skip Bachalpsee because the return hike would make Lauterbrunnen too rushed.

2026-07-29.title: Early lunch at First
2026-07-29.detail: Have a quick lunch or coffee at the mountain restaurant.
2026-07-29.note: Recommended: First Mountain Restaurant. Order soup, rösti, sandwich, coffee or cake.

2026-07-29.title: Gondola descent
2026-07-29.detail: Return by gondola to Grindelwald village. Check the next Kleine Scheidegg train during the descent.
2026-07-29.note: Leave First by 12:00 at the latest.

2026-07-29.title: Walk to railway station
2026-07-29.detail: Walk directly from the First gondola station to Grindelwald railway station.
2026-07-29.note: Buy water or a snack only if time permits.

2026-07-29.title: Grindelwald → Kleine Scheidegg
2026-07-29.detail: Take the Wengernalp Railway up beneath the Eiger.
2026-07-29.note: Sit near a window and keep your camera ready.

2026-07-29.title: Kleine Scheidegg
2026-07-29.detail: Walk around the station, photograph the Eiger north face and views toward Mönch and Jungfrau.
2026-07-29.note: Backup snack: Bergrestaurant Kleine Scheidegg or Restaurant Eigernordwand.

2026-07-29.title: Kleine Scheidegg → Wengen → Lauterbrunnen
2026-07-29.detail: Take the scenic cogwheel train downhill. Remain on the train through Wengen unless a change is required.
2026-07-29.note: Look down toward Lauterbrunnen Valley and its waterfalls.

2026-07-29.title: Lauterbrunnen village
2026-07-29.detail: Walk from the station through the village toward Staubbach Falls. Photograph the waterfall, chalets and cliff walls.
2026-07-29.note: Do not climb behind Staubbach Falls because Trümmelbach is the priority.

2026-07-29.title: Bus to Trümmelbach Falls
2026-07-29.detail: Take Bus 141 toward Stechelberg and get off at Trümmelbachfälle.
2026-07-29.note: Keep your pass or bus ticket ready.

2026-07-29.title: Trümmelbach Falls
2026-07-29.detail: Allow 75–80 minutes for the lift, internal galleries and lower sections. Walk carefully because surfaces are wet.
2026-07-29.note: Wear shoes with good grip. Admission is usually separate from standard rail passes.

2026-07-29.title: Return bus
2026-07-29.detail: Take Bus 141 back to Lauterbrunnen station.
2026-07-29.note: Leave the falls by approximately 17:05.

2026-07-29.title: Lauterbrunnen → Zweilütschinen → Grindelwald
2026-07-29.detail: Travel back to Grindelwald, changing at Zweilütschinen when required.
2026-07-29.note: Check the train destination carefully because services divide toward different valleys.

2026-07-29.title: Hotel check-in
2026-07-29.detail: Check in, collect luggage, shower and change.
2026-07-29.note: Keep the break short so you can still enjoy the evening.

2026-07-29.title: Dinner
2026-07-29.detail: Have a relaxed dinner in central Grindelwald.
2026-07-29.note: Recommended: Barry's Restaurant, Bar & Lounge. Reserve around 19:30. Try Swiss dishes, grilled meat or rösti.
2026-07-29.map_query: Barry's Restaurant, Bar & Lounge, Grindelwald, Switzerland

2026-07-29.title: Evening village walk
2026-07-29.detail: Walk along Dorfstrasse and look for sunset or evening light on the Eiger.
2026-07-29.note: Buy water, fruit and snacks for the next morning.

2026-07-29.title: Prepare Day 2 route
2026-07-29.detail: Search in SBB: Grindelwald → Zermatt via Kandersteg. Pack most of your luggage.
2026-07-29.note: Entering “via Kandersteg” prevents the app from routing you through the faster base tunnel.

2026-07-30.title: Breakfast
2026-07-30.detail: Have a full hotel breakfast. Check SBB, Zermatt weather and the Matterhorn webcam.
2026-07-30.note: Take water and snacks for the train.

2026-07-30.title: Checkout
2026-07-30.detail: Check out and keep your luggage with you throughout the journey.
2026-07-30.note: Confirm that your route is displayed via Kandersteg.

2026-07-30.title: Grindelwald → Interlaken Ost
2026-07-30.detail: Take the morning train down from Grindelwald.
2026-07-30.note: Avoid very tight connections when possible because you have luggage.

2026-07-30.title: Interlaken Ost → Spiez
2026-07-30.detail: Continue along Lake Thun to Spiez.
2026-07-30.note: Sit on the lake-facing side when available.

2026-07-30.title: Spiez connection
2026-07-30.detail: Locate the regional train via Frutigen and Kandersteg.
2026-07-30.note: Buy coffee only if you have sufficient connection time.

2026-07-30.title: Historic Lötschberg mountain line
2026-07-30.detail: Travel Spiez → Frutigen → Kandersteg → Brig using the older mountain route. Enjoy viaducts, curves, mountain valleys and the descent into the Rhône Valley.
2026-07-30.note: Try the right-hand side from Spiez toward Brig, though scenery is visible on both sides.

2026-07-30.title: Change at Brig
2026-07-30.detail: Follow signs for Visp and Zermatt.
2026-07-30.note: Keep luggage close because platform changes may be quick.

2026-07-30.title: Brig → Visp
2026-07-30.detail: Take the short train to Visp.
2026-07-30.note: Check the departure board for the Matterhorn Gotthard Railway.

2026-07-30.title: Visp → Zermatt
2026-07-30.detail: Continue through the Matter Valley to car-free Zermatt.
2026-07-30.note: Expected arrival approximately 12:45–13:15.

2026-07-30.title: Hotel check-in / luggage drop
2026-07-30.detail: Choose or use a hotel within 10 minutes of Zermatt station. Leave luggage if the room is not ready.
2026-07-30.note: Ask for an early breakfast or breakfast box for Day 3.

2026-07-30.title: Light lunch
2026-07-30.detail: Have a fast bakery-style lunch rather than a long sit-down meal.
2026-07-30.note: Recommended: Fuchs Bakery & Bistro. Sandwich, soup, quiche, pastry and coffee.

2026-07-30.title: Bahnhofplatz and Bahnhofstrasse
2026-07-30.detail: Begin at the railway station and walk down Zermatt's main street. Note the Gornergrat station opposite the main station.
2026-07-30.note: Identify a supermarket for tomorrow's snacks.

2026-07-30.title: Hinterdorf
2026-07-30.detail: Explore traditional timber houses, old granaries and narrow lanes.
2026-07-30.note: Walk slowly; the historic area is compact.

2026-07-30.title: St. Mauritius Church area
2026-07-30.detail: Visit the church square, Mountaineers' Cemetery and Matterhorn Museum exterior.
2026-07-30.note: Keep the cemetery visit respectful and quiet.

2026-07-30.title: Kirchbrücke viewpoint
2026-07-30.detail: Walk to the classic Matterhorn viewpoint over the river.
2026-07-30.note: Wait several minutes if clouds are passing.

2026-07-30.title: Flexible village time
2026-07-30.detail: Browse shops, have coffee or return to the hotel for a short rest.
2026-07-30.note: Optional Sunnegga only when the Matterhorn is clear and tomorrow's forecast is poor.

2026-07-30.title: Hotel rest and preparation
2026-07-30.detail: Prepare mountain clothing, walking shoes, ticket, water and camera for Gornergrat. Pack most of your suitcase.
2026-07-30.note: Avoid a long nap.

2026-07-30.title: Dinner
2026-07-30.detail: Enjoy traditional Valais food.
2026-07-30.note: Recommended: Schäferstube. Reserve around 19:00. Good for raclette, fondue, lamb and regional dishes.

2026-07-30.title: Evening viewpoint
2026-07-30.detail: Return briefly to Kirchbrücke or the church square for sunset views.
2026-07-30.note: The Matterhorn may clear in the evening even after a cloudy afternoon.

2026-07-30.title: Return to hotel
2026-07-30.detail: Finalise packing and set alarms.
2026-07-30.note: Avoid excessive alcohol because of the early altitude excursion.

2026-07-31.title: Wake and weather check
2026-07-31.detail: Check Gornergrat webcam, Matterhorn visibility, wind, rain radar and trail conditions.
2026-07-31.note: Maintain the early train unless conditions are expected to improve shortly.

2026-07-31.title: Breakfast
2026-07-31.detail: Eat the hotel's early breakfast or breakfast box.
2026-07-31.note: Drink water but avoid a very heavy meal.

2026-07-31.title: Leave luggage
2026-07-31.detail: Check out when possible and leave the suitcase with reception.

2026-07-31.title: Walk to Gornergrat station
2026-07-31.detail: Walk to the Gornergrat Railway station opposite Zermatt station.
2026-07-31.note: Arrive early for a window seat.

2026-07-31.title: Zermatt → Gornergrat
2026-07-31.detail: Take the first summer cogwheel train to approximately 3,100 metres.
2026-07-31.note: Try the right-hand side for many of the Matterhorn views.

2026-07-31.title: Gornergrat summit
2026-07-31.detail: Visit the viewing platform, Matterhorn viewpoint, Gorner Glacier viewpoint and summit area. Walk slowly because of the altitude.
2026-07-31.note: Have coffee or a light breakfast at the summit restaurant or self-service café.

2026-07-31.title: Gornergrat → Rotenboden
2026-07-31.detail: Take the next downhill train one or two stops to Rotenboden.

2026-07-31.title: Walk to Riffelsee
2026-07-31.detail: Walk approximately 10 minutes to the lake and allow photography time.
2026-07-31.note: Walk past the first viewpoint to find a quieter reflection spot.

2026-07-31.title: Hike to Riffelberg
2026-07-31.detail: Follow the marked trail Riffelsee → Riffelberg, approximately 3.1 km and one hour, mostly downhill.
2026-07-31.note: Use proper walking shoes. Do not hike in heavy rain, poor visibility or when feeling unwell.

2026-07-31.title: Brunch at Riffelberg
2026-07-31.detail: Rest and have an early lunch or substantial snack.
2026-07-31.note: Choose a Riffelberg mountain restaurant for rösti, soup, pasta, sandwich, coffee or cake.

2026-07-31.title: Riffelberg → Zermatt
2026-07-31.detail: Take the Gornergrat train back to Zermatt.
2026-07-31.note: Aim to reach Zermatt no later than 12:30.

2026-07-31.title: Final Zermatt time
2026-07-31.detail: Collect luggage, use the restroom, buy water and take final Matterhorn photographs.
2026-07-31.note: Have lunch only if you did not eat at Riffelberg.

2026-07-31.title: Zermatt → Visp
2026-07-31.detail: Take a Matterhorn Gotthard Railway service down the valley.
2026-07-31.note: Leave Zermatt by approximately 14:30 at the latest.

2026-07-31.title: Visp → Brig
2026-07-31.detail: Change to a short train to Brig.
2026-07-31.note: Keep an eye on the platform and connection time.

2026-07-31.title: Check in at Hotel de Londres
2026-07-31.detail: Walk from Brig station to the hotel and check in. Request an early breakfast box and settle the bill if convenient.
2026-07-31.note: Save your international train ticket offline.

2026-07-31.title: Café break
2026-07-31.detail: Rest with coffee and cake before sightseeing.

2026-07-31.title: Brig old town
2026-07-31.detail: Walk through the historic centre and see Stockalper Palace, its courtyard when accessible, Sebastian Square and old streets.
2026-07-31.note: A full palace tour is unnecessary.

2026-07-31.title: Dinner
2026-07-31.note: Recommended: Restaurant Channa. Alternative: Schlosskeller for a more refined setting.

2026-07-31.title: Prepare for Italy
2026-07-31.detail: Pack fully, organise passport, tickets, Milan hotel details, ferry schedule screenshots and daypack.
2026-07-31.note: Set two alarms and confirm the Brig departure platform.

2026-08-01.title: Wake and breakfast
2026-08-01.detail: Eat your breakfast box, complete checkout and check the international train status.
2026-08-01.note: Keep passport and ticket in an easily accessible pocket.

2026-08-01.title: Walk to Brig station
2026-08-01.detail: Leave Hotel de Londres and walk to the station.
2026-08-01.note: Arrive at least 20 minutes before the train.

2026-08-01.title: Brig → Milano Centrale
2026-08-01.detail: Take the earliest suitable direct or one-change international train via the Simplon route.
2026-08-01.note: Backup working target: approximately 07:44–09:50. Confirm exact times in SBB.

2026-08-01.title: Store luggage in Milan
2026-08-01.detail: Use the staffed luggage facility at or near Milano Centrale. Photograph the receipt and note closing time.
2026-08-01.note: Keep passport, valuables and medicines with you.

2026-08-01.title: Milan → Varenna-Esino
2026-08-01.detail: Take a direct Trenord train. The journey is approximately 65 minutes.
2026-08-01.note: Avoid the last carriage because Varenna's platform can be short.

2026-08-01.title: Station → waterfront
2026-08-01.detail: Walk downhill from Varenna-Esino station toward the lake and ferry terminal.
2026-08-01.note: Remember that the return walk is uphill.

2026-08-01.title: Check ferry arrangements
2026-08-01.detail: Locate the ticket office, check Bellagio departures and purchase tickets when possible.
2026-08-01.note: Confirm which queue is for your boat.

2026-08-01.title: Varenna walking tour
2026-08-01.detail: Walk the Passeggiata degli Innamorati, harbour, Piazza San Giorgio, Church of San Giorgio and old lanes.
2026-08-01.note: Keep track of time because the town is steep and lanes can be confusing.

2026-08-01.title: Café stop
2026-08-01.detail: Have a short coffee break near the waterfront.
2026-08-01.note: Recommended: Varenna Caffè Bistrot. Espresso, cappuccino, pastry or cold drink.

2026-08-01.title: Lunch in Varenna
2026-08-01.detail: Have a one-hour lakeside or old-town lunch. Tell the restaurant you need to leave on time.
2026-08-01.note: Recommended: Al Prato. Alternative: Il Cavatappi. Reserve in advance.

2026-08-01.title: Return to ferry terminal
2026-08-01.detail: Walk back, check the departure board and join the correct queue.
2026-08-01.note: Arrive 20–30 minutes before the ferry.

2026-08-01.title: Ferry Varenna → Bellagio
2026-08-01.detail: Cross the central lake and enjoy views from the outdoor deck.
2026-08-01.note: Keep a light jacket accessible because it can be breezy.

2026-08-01.title: Bellagio waterfront
2026-08-01.detail: Walk around Piazza Mazzini and the lakeside promenade.
2026-08-01.note: Photograph the Varenna and mountain views.

2026-08-01.title: Salita Serbelloni
2026-08-01.detail: Climb the famous stepped street and photograph the lake from the upper section.
2026-08-01.note: Walk carefully on polished stone surfaces.

2026-08-01.title: Bellagio old town
2026-08-01.detail: Explore Via Giuseppe Garibaldi, the Basilica area, boutiques and lake viewpoints.
2026-08-01.note: Avoid shopping too long because ferry queues can build.

2026-08-01.title: Gelato break
2026-08-01.detail: Have a quick gelato or cold drink.
2026-08-01.note: Choose takeaway rather than a seated café.

2026-08-01.title: Return to ferry terminal
2026-08-01.detail: Join the return queue early.
2026-08-01.note: Confirm that the boat stops at Varenna.

2026-08-01.title: Bellagio → Varenna
2026-08-01.detail: Take the ferry back to Varenna.
2026-08-01.note: Keep the official ferry timetable screenshot available.

2026-08-01.title: Walk to Varenna station
2026-08-01.detail: Walk uphill to Varenna-Esino station.
2026-08-01.note: Allow at least 15–20 minutes and do not stop for another meal.

2026-08-01.title: Varenna → Milano Centrale
2026-08-01.detail: Take a direct evening Trenord train.
2026-08-01.note: Do not rely on the final train of the evening.

2026-08-01.title: Collect luggage
2026-08-01.detail: Retrieve your suitcase from storage immediately.
2026-08-01.note: Check the receipt and all belongings before leaving.

2026-08-01.title: Milan hotel check-in and dinner
2026-08-01.detail: Travel to your hotel, check in and have a flexible dinner nearby.
2026-08-01.note: Use a restaurant close to the hotel or the Milano Centrale food hall to avoid crossing the city late.
